errors.text: The predicted direction is opposite to the target result: the hypothesis claims SRO suppresses lattice conductivity, whereas the target finds an approximately 12% enhancement.

The proposed resonant-scattering and increased-anharmonicity mechanism is not supported by the cited evidence and misses the target mechanisms of reduced lattice distortion and high-conductivity percolation through HfTi and TiZr SRO clusters.
Mechanical evidence that SRO impedes dislocation motion is improperly extrapolated to phonon transport; dislocation friction does not establish stronger phonon scattering.
The response substitutes MoNbTaW and fcc-derived L12/L11 or Cr-Ni/Co motifs for the target bcc HfNbTaTiZr system and its B2-like binary clusters.
The cited papers do not directly demonstrate an SRO-induced reduction of lattice thermal conductivity in a refractory HEA.
